name: PhotoBerry Studio for Photographers – Image Selection, Proofing, Watermarking & Client Management
author: BerryPress

sections.description:
Meet PhotoBerry Studio – Manager for Photographers 📸

PhotoBerry Studio is a feature-rich WordPress plugin built specifically for photographers. Seamlessly integrated with your WordPress site, it provides a complete solution to enhance and streamline your photography workflow. With advanced tools for image organization, gallery management, and client proofing, it transforms the way you work.

From managing client sessions and securely storing photos to collecting feedback and handling revisions, PhotoBerry Studio takes the complexity out of the process. Empower your clients to interact with their images by leaving comments, selecting favorites, and sharing feedback, creating a smooth and professional collaboration experience.

Watch the PhotoBerry Studio Promo Video

Discover how PhotoBerry Studio can revolutionize your photography workflow. Click the video to watch!

Why Choose PhotoBerry Studio?

Flexible sharing options:
– 🔗 Share galleries via a unique link.
– 🔒 Secure sessions with a password.
– 👤 Require client login for enhanced security.
– ✉️ Send link invites to clients.
– 🌐 Make galleries publicly accessible for broader sharing.

Impress Your Clients
– 🌐 Provide seamless gallery access with a polished, branded experience.
– ✅ Simplify image selection and feedback with intuitive commenting tools.
– 📥 Allow clients to easily download their final selections.

Optimize Your Workflow
– 📂 Organize sessions, revisions, and client feedback in a single, streamlined dashboard.
– 📤 Deliver high-quality files effortlessly with customizable delivery options.

Safeguard Your Work
– 🔒 Protect your images with customizable watermarks.
– 👤 Ensure only authorized clients can access galleries with secure sharing options.

Unlock More with Pro
– Upgrade to Pro for advanced features like personalized watermarks, secure cloud storage, automated delivery, multi-client support, and much more!
– 🚀 Join the Pro Beta Program FOR FREE!

Key Features

Image Gallery Creation – Create stunning galleries with tools to:
– 🖼️ Set an image as the gallery cover.
– 💬 Allow comments for detailed feedback.
– 🎨 Choose from Multiple Layouts: tailor your gallery’s appearance.
– 💡 Lightbox View: Enhance the viewing experience with a modern, immersive display.

Client Sessions Management – Organize client projects into sessions.
– ✅ Proofing tools let clients mark favorites, comment, and approve images.
– 📌 Mark images as suggested.
– 🔄 Upload and manage image revisions based on feedback.
– ⬇️ Clients can download images directly from the session gallery.

Watermarking
– 🛡️ Add watermarks to protect your photos.

Centralized Dashboard
– 📋View and manage all sessions in one place.

Pro Version Features

Unlock more possibilities with PhotoBerry Pro:
– ☁️ Secure cloud storage for easy access to your images anywhere.
– 🖼️ Personalized watermarks for professional branding.
– 📦 Automated delivery in web- and print-ready formats.
– 👥 Assign multiple clients to a single session.
– 🛠️ Customizable email templates for communication.
– 📷 Upload RAW files directly to save time.

Ready to Elevate Your Photography Business?

  • 📋 Plugin Documentation PhotoBerry Studio Documentation
  • 🌟 Watch Our Promo Video
  • 📮 Request a Feature
  • 🚀 Join the Pro Beta Program FOR FREE!
  • 🔗 Visit PhotoBerryStudio.com and subscribe our newsletter for updates, tips, and exclusive offers!

Future Features (Coming Soon)

Future versions will include expanded functionality such as:
– WooCommerce Integration: Sell photography sessions and images directly from your website.
– Team Collaboration: Features to support team workflows and collaboration.
– Event-Specific Tools: Offer guest galleries and other event-related features.

Privacy Policy and Data Usage

This plugin integrates with MailChimp to provide email newsletter subscriptions. When users subscribe, their data (email address) is securely submitted to MailChimp via their hosted signup form. The data is used solely for managing subscriptions and sending updates.

We do not store or process this data directly through the plugin. Data is handled by MailChimp in accordance with their Privacy Policy. Users must explicitly consent to data submission during signup. Data is securely transmitted and not stored locally.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin
  2. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/photoberry-studio directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  4. Navigate to the PhotoBerry Studio settings page to configure your preferences and start creating galleries.
sections.faq:
Supported Image Formats and Size Restrictions

PhotoBerry Studio currently supports the following extensions: “.jpeg”, “.jpg”, “.png”, and “.webp”.
There are no inherent size restrictions within the plugin itself; however, any limitations will depend on the user’s hosting provider. It’s important to verify your hosting plan’s file upload size allowances to ensure smooth uploads and performance.

Where Are Images Stored?

PhotoBerry Studio intentionally keeps gallery images separate from your main media library. This helps avoid any accidental use of gallery images in blog posts or portfolios. Separating these images prevents your media library from becoming cluttered and overwhelming, especially with potentially hundreds or thousands of gallery images.

Additionally, PhotoBerry Studio ensures that when you delete a gallery, all related images are automatically removed from the server to free up storage space.

Does this plugin support WordPress Multisite?

Currently, WordPress Multisite is not supported. However, we are actively considering it for future development. If you’d like to see Multisite support added, please vote for the feature request [here] (https://photoberrystudio.com/feature-requests/wordpress-multisite-support/). Your feedback plays a crucial role in shaping our plugin roadmap.

How can I report security bugs?

You can report security bugs through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team helps validate, triage and handle any security vulnerabilities. Report a security vulnerability.
